notes.summary: Art and culture gives 1 to 3 questions in each paper. Past papers ask most about festivals and their states, then folk and classical dances, music and instruments, and monuments. Nearly every question is a pair: dance and state, instrument and player, festival and state, temple and builder. Learn them as pairs in tables.

concepts.title: Classical dances
concepts.body:
The Sangeet Natak Akademi recognises eight classical dances. Kerala has two (Kathakali and Mohiniyattam). The Ministry of Culture also lists Chhau, which makes nine. The base text for all classical dance is Bharata Muni's Natya Shastra.

KathakaliKeralaDance-drama with heavy make-up; Kalamandalam Gopi; poet Vallathol founded Kerala Kalamandalam (1930)

concepts.title: Music: Hindustani and Carnatic
concepts.body:
• Hindustani (north) vocal forms: Dhrupad (oldest, Dagar family), Khayal, Thumri, Tappa, Dadra, Ghazal. Qawwali is Sufi devotional music; Amir Khusrau is called its father. Nusrat Fateh Ali Khan was a famous qawwal.
  • Carnatic (south) forms: Kriti, Varnam, Tillana, Javali. Purandara Dasa is called the father of Carnatic music. The Carnatic trinity: Tyagaraja, Muthuswami Dikshitar, Syama Shastri.
  • A raga is the melody framework; a tala is the rhythm cycle.

concepts.title: Instruments and players
concepts.body:
The Natya Shastra groups instruments into four types: tata (string), sushira (wind), avanaddha (skin drums) and ghana (solid, struck, like cymbals and ghatam).

The santoor is a hammered string instrument from Kashmir. The Saraswati veena is the main Carnatic string instrument; the Bobbili veena is a style from Andhra Pradesh. The pung is a drum used in Manipuri dance.

concepts.title: Temple styles and famous temples
concepts.body:

concepts.title: UNESCO World Heritage Sites in India
concepts.body:
India's first sites (1983): Ajanta, Ellora, Agra Fort and Taj Mahal. The total grows every year, so check the latest number before the exam.

Recent sitesYear added
Ramappa Temple (Telangana), Dholavira (Gujarat)2021
Santiniketan (West Bengal), Sacred Ensembles of the Hoysalas (Karnataka)2023
Moidams of the Ahom dynasty, Charaideo (Assam)2024
Maratha Military Landscapes (forts in Maharashtra and Tamil Nadu)2025

Natural sites: Kaziranga and Manas (Assam), Keoladeo (Rajasthan), Sundarbans (West Bengal), Nanda Devi and Valley of Flowers (Uttarakhand), Western Ghats, Great Himalayan National Park (Himachal). Mixed site: Khangchendzonga National Park (Sikkim).

Other well-known cultural sites: Sanchi stupa and Khajuraho and Bhimbetka (Madhya Pradesh), Mahabodhi Temple (Bodh Gaya, Bihar), Nalanda (Bihar), Hampi and Pattadakal (Karnataka), Konark (Odisha), Qutub Minar, Red Fort and Humayun's Tomb (Delhi), Fatehpur Sikri (UP), Rani ki Vav (Patan, Gujarat), Jaipur city, Hill forts of Rajasthan, Mountain Railways of India.

varieties.name: Classical dances
varieties.how: Learn the eight dances with state and two dancers each. Remember Kerala has two, and Sattriya (Assam) was added last.

example.q: Siddhendra Yogi is linked to which classical dance?
steps: Siddhendra Yogi shaped the dance in the village of Kuchipudi.
So he is the Adi Guru of Kuchipudi (Andhra Pradesh).

varieties.name: Folk dances, theatre and martial arts
varieties.how: Learn folk dance, theatre and martial art by state. Separate classical names first, then the rest are folk.

example.q: Mardani Khel is a martial art of which state?
steps: Kalaripayattu is Kerala, Gatka is Punjab, Thang-Ta is Manipur.
Mardani Khel is the Maratha weapon art of Maharashtra.

varieties.name: Music forms and gharanas
varieties.how: Sort the option into Hindustani or Carnatic first, then vocal or instrumental, then gharana.

example.q: Which of these is NOT a vocal form of Hindustani music: Dhrupad, Khayal, Thumri, Kriti?
steps: Dhrupad, Khayal and Thumri are Hindustani vocal forms.
Kriti is a Carnatic composition form.

varieties.name: Instruments and players
varieties.how: Remember one star player for each instrument and the four instrument families.

example.q: Pandit Shivkumar Sharma was famous for which instrument?
steps: Shivkumar Sharma brought the Kashmiri santoor to classical music.

varieties.name: Festivals and fairs
varieties.how: Group festivals by region. North-east tribal festivals are asked most: learn the tribe as well as the state.

example.q: The Hornbill Festival is celebrated in which state?
steps: It is held every December at Kisama, near Kohima.

varieties.name: Architecture and heritage sites
varieties.how: Learn monument, place and builder together. For temple styles: Nagara north, Dravida south, Vesara Deccan.

example.q: The Kailasa temple, cut from a single rock, is at:
steps: It was built by the Rashtrakuta king Krishna I.

varieties.name: Paintings, textiles and crafts
varieties.how: Make a state-wise list of painting, textile and craft. Many names include the place (Banarasi, Chanderi, Channapatna).

example.q: Warli painting belongs to which state?
steps: Warli is a tribe of the Sahyadri region.
Their white-on-mud paintings come from Maharashtra.

varieties.name: Artists, titles and institutions
varieties.how: Learn the title and the person together, and the founder of each academy or school.

steps: Kalakshetra is a school for Bharatanatyam and arts.
It was founded in 1936 by Rukmini Devi Arundale.

tips: Eight classical dances, one hook: 'Bharat Ka Kathak Kuchh Odd Manipuri Mohini Sattra' gives Bharatanatyam, Kathakali, Kathak, Kuchipudi, Odissi, Manipuri, Mohiniyattam, Sattriya.
Names often carry the place: Kuchipudi (village), Banarasi (Varanasi), Patola of Patan, Channapatna toys.
Bihu comes three times a year: Rongali (April), Kongali or Kati (October), Bhogali (January).
Shadow puppets are southern and eastern: Tholu Bommalata (Andhra), Togalu Gombeyata (Karnataka), Ravanachhaya (Odisha).
Carnatic trinity: T, D, S gives Tyagaraja, Dikshitar, Syama Shastri.
Konark (Sun) and Puri (Jagannath) are both in Odisha; Modhera Sun Temple is in Gujarat.
traps: Ghoomar is a folk dance of Rajasthan, not Gujarat; Garba is Gujarat.
Kathakali and Mohiniyattam are both Kerala; Kuchipudi is Andhra Pradesh, not Kerala or Tamil Nadu.
Chhau is shared by Odisha, West Bengal and Jharkhand; Chholiya is Uttarakhand.
Yakshagana is Karnataka's dance-drama, while Koodiyattam is Kerala's Sanskrit theatre.
Amjad Ali Khan plays the sarod, not the sitar; Bismillah Khan played the shehnai.

questions.q: Kuchipudi is a classical dance form of which state?
questions.solution:
Kuchipudi comes from the village of Kuchipudi in Andhra Pradesh.
Memory hook: Kuchipudi is named after its home village in AP.

questions.q: The Taj Mahal was built by:
questions.solution:
Shah Jahan built the Taj Mahal at Agra in memory of his wife Mumtaz Mahal.
Memory hook: Shah Jahan, the 'builder emperor': Taj Mahal and the Red Fort of Delhi.

questions.q: Pandit Shivkumar Sharma was a famous player of which instrument?
questions.solution:
Pt. Shivkumar Sharma popularised the santoor, a hammered string instrument from Jammu and Kashmir, in classical music.
Memory hook: Shivkumar Sharma — Santoor.

questions.q: Which state has two classical dance forms recognised by the Sangeet Natak Akademi?
questions.solution:
Kerala has Kathakali and Mohiniyattam.
Memory hook: Kerala = 'K' and 'M': Kathakali and Mohiniyattam.

questions.q: The Hornbill Festival is celebrated in:
questions.solution:
The Hornbill Festival is held every December in Nagaland and showcases its tribes.
Memory hook: The hornbill bird is honoured in Naga culture: Hornbill = Nagaland.

questions.q: The Konark Sun Temple is located in which state?
questions.solution:
The Konark Sun Temple is in Odisha; it was built by King Narasimhadeva I of the Eastern Ganga dynasty in the 13th century. It is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
Memory hook: Konark is shaped like the Sun God's chariot, on the Odisha coast.

questions.q: Which of the following pairs (dance — state) is incorrectly matched?
questions.solution:
Ghoomar is a folk dance of Rajasthan. Gujarat's famous folk dance is Garba.
Memory hook: Ghoomar 'twirls' in the royal courts of Rajasthan.

questions.q: The Kailasa temple, carved out of a single rock, is part of which cave complex?
questions.solution:
The Kailasa temple (Cave 16) at Ellora, Maharashtra, was carved from one rock under the Rashtrakuta king Krishna I.
Memory hook: Ajanta = paintings, Ellora = rock-cut Kailasa.
